capabilities: Autocomplete LaTeX commands inside $...$ and $$...$$ math
Show Chinese and English descriptions for each command
Configure completion keybindings such as Tab, Enter, or Ctrl+N
Restrict suggestions to math contexts, excluding code blocks and plain Markdown
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX renderer, editor, or AI math assistant; it only completes command names while you type inside math expressions.
extras: Installable only manually from a GitHub Release; not yet listed in the Obsidian Community Plugins registry and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile is untested, and other completion plugins may conflict on the same shortcuts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command completion for LaTeX, so writers of math expressions must recall and type command names like \partial by hand.
summary: Offline autocomplete plugin that suggests LaTeX commands inside inline and display math, with Chinese/English descriptions and configurable completion keys.
